Container.Name: hemlock-docker
Container.Overview: Hemlock in your browser: an independent, open-source take on the Nightshade method. Artists upload one or many images, the server adds faint targeted changes that make AI models that scrape the image learn the wrong thing, and they download the protected images (or a zip) together with the ALT-text tags to post with them. Compare before and after by pressing and holding the result. Runs on an NVIDIA GPU (install the Nvidia Driver plugin, driver 570 or newer, and keep --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters). About 20 seconds per image on a mid-range card at the default quality; on the CPU it is far slower. Stable Diffusion 1.5 (about 2.5 GB) and two small tagging models download into the data folder on first start. Uploaded images are deleted after an hour. There is no login unless you set a password below, so keep it on your LAN or put it behind a reverse proxy. A deterrent, not a guarantee, and not affiliated with the Nightshade team.
Container.Requires: Install the Nvidia Driver plugin. No GPU? Remove --runtime=nvidia from Extra Parameters and it runs on the CPU, very slowly.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Web interface. 7861 so it can run next to mist-docker on 7860.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Model cache (about 4 GB), optional concepts.txt / mapping.json, and temporary job files.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: Which GPU to use: all, or a GPU UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin page.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional. When set, the page asks for it. Leave empty for no login.

Config.Name: Username
Config.Description: Optional username to go with the password. Empty means the username is hemlock.

Config.Name: Max images per run
Config.Description: How many images one run may contain. Each run holds the GPU, so keep this modest on shared servers.

Config.Name: Queue length
Config.Description: How many runs may wait their turn before new ones are turned away.

Config.Name: Delete uploads after (minutes)
Config.Description: How long uploaded and finished images stay on the server before they are removed.

Config.Name: Automatic tag detection
Config.Description: 1 downloads two small models that name each image and pick a target concept. 0 skips them (type the tag yourself, targets are picked from the word list).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns created files (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns created files (100 = users).
